sentences.en: The yacht was at the mercy of the dreadful storm.
sentences.zh: 帆船在可怕的风暴中任凭摆布。

sentences.en: It is dreadful that a nuclear crisis has hit Japan.
sentences.zh: 日本发生核危机真是可怕的事情。

sentences.en: I had a feeling that something dreadful was happening.
sentences.zh: 我感觉有什么可怕的事情正在发生。

senses.zh: 可怕的,令人畏惧的,讨厌的，糟透了的，丑陋的,糟糕的n.<英>惊险小说杂志
